name: Dayton and Armitage Latin Kings
description: The Dayton and Armitage Latin Kings were a Latin Kings street gang set active in the Dayton and Armitage neighborhood of Chicago, Illinois. By 1970 they were among the primary rivals of the CORP, a white greaser gang operating north of the Cabrini Green housing projects. Conflicts between the two gangs became severe enough that the Chicago Police Department assigned a dedicated gang squad unit to the Waller High School area, with the field across from the school nicknamed 'Vietnam' for the intensity of the fighting. They shared a corner with the Young Lords, who operated a church on the same block, and both groups were listed among the CORP's main enemies.
